name: Universe Conflict
detailed_description:
Special Offer

A Special Gift for Our O.A.C - World Begins Players!

As a thank-you to our amazing community, all existing owners of O.A.C - World Begins will receive Universe Conflict completely free!

Existing O.A.C - World Begins players will be notified soon on how to claim their free copy of Universe Conflict.

Please don’t forget to follow the announcements.


Important Notice: This opportunity is exclusively available to existing O.A.C players before June 10, 2025.

Best regards.


About the Game

Universe Conflict is a single-player FPS experience that offers story-driven and action-packed gameplay. Players take control of an elite agent working within the secret operations of the Nexashield corporation. Your mission is to infiltrate enemy lines, uncover conspiracies, and survive deadly covert operations.

In the game, players will:

  • Take on missions as an agent equipped with a variety of weapons and gear,

  • Complete objectives that require different strategies and skills,

  • Manage their weapons and items through an inventory system,

  • Engage in intense combat while also making tactical and stealth-based decisions,

  • Uncover dark secrets through a deep and immersive narrative.

Universe Conflict aims to deliver an unforgettable FPS experience by combining action, stealth, and powerful storytelling.


WARNING:

The story, visuals, and narrative presented in this game are entirely fictional. The setting and timeline are fictional, and any resemblance to actual persons, organizations, events, or places is purely coincidental. They bear no relation to real-world entities in any form.

At an unknown point in time...

Unpredictable attacks, raids, and chaos have become an undeniable reality. The world is no longer governed by nations but by powerful corporations. Security, law enforcement, and warfare technologies have been fully privatized. The five major continents are under the control of ruthless corporate conglomerates, and order is maintained by elite operatives like you.

You are an agent of Nexashield, a high-tech security company. Your unit is called Regamots... and there are millions like you. Once just an ordinary security firm, Nexashield has grown although the public is not fully aware into a company specializing in armed "purification" operations. Infiltrating hostile zones, neutralizing threats, and uncovering corporate conspiracies are just a few of the many missions carried out by specialized units like yours!

Short Story

Set in an alternate, undefined timeline, this is a story-driven first-person shooter. A sudden and unexpected global shift has forced humanity to unite. Across the world, private security companies have taken over the responsibility of not just city, but even national defense...

As humanity enters an early stage of all-out war, internal threats, raiders and corporate power struggles continue relentlessly. The dark future symbolizes a time when the struggle for survival has reached its peak. Technology may have fallen short of expectations, but this won’t stop humanity from resisting a far greater threat. The invasion has forced mankind to confront its own history—and its primal survival instincts.

In the aftermath, the nations of the world formed a global alliance and united under a single leadership, divided into four major factions:

  • ACU – American Continental Union

  • EUN – European Union of Nations

  • EC – Eastern Confederation

  • GSCU – Greater Southern Continent Union

Each region has united its forces under a single command to fight against a global threat. However, this alliance marks the beginning of a new internal conflict. As each region seeks to protect its own interests, the war transforms into a struggle not only against external enemies but also against rising tensions and clashing ideologies within.

You are a highly trained special forces operative and I hope you always remain that way, Planck...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 | AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Development and optimization for low-end systems is ongoing. Optimization efforts are ongoing to enhance performance, graphics quality, and ensure stable frame rates on lower-end systems. Minimum system requirements are being progressively optimized to accommodate a broader range of hardware specifications.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 | AMD Ryzen™ 7 8700
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The above requirements include hardware optimized with the highest tested quality graphics.
